target_customer: Developers and companies that need consistent, verifiable output for OCR, extraction, classification and speech tasks
problem: General LLMs are inconsistent on tasks like document OCR and structured extraction. Interfaze merges specialist DNN and CNN models with a transformer to give repeatable output with confidence scores and bounding boxes.
business_model: Usage-based API (OpenAI-compatible) plus an open-weight Lite model under Apache 2.0
product_category: AI model for deterministic document, vision and audio tasks

founders.name: Yoeven D Khemlani
previous_startups: Second-time founder per YC profile; earlier company not named on the YC page
founders.background_notes: YC page: 8 years in edge computer vision, on-device models and OCR/scraping backend work. Education and employers not listed.

founders.name: Harsha Vardhan Khurdula
founders.background_notes: YC page: 5+ years in computer vision, small-model reinforcement learning, and multiple peer-reviewed papers.

competitors.name: LightOnOCR-2
competitors.what: Open compact OCR model under Apache 2.0
competitors.traction_then: claimed top score on OlmOCR-Bench by its authors

competitors.name: Pulse (Runpulse)
competitors.what: Hybrid agentic OCR and extraction with deterministic-only option

technical_complexity.rationale: A new mixed architecture combining CNN/DNN specialists with transformers, with an arXiv paper accepted to IEEE CAI 2026, is near research grade for a five-person team.

defensibility.rationale: Large labs and OCR specialists ship competing models quickly; the open-weight Lite model lowers lock-in. Benchmarks are self-published.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not known yet; labs ship document models regularly.

market_need_then: Developers building document and extraction pipelines complained about LLM inconsistency; ABBYY and others were also marketing hybrid deterministic plus generative document AI in 2026, a sign of demand.

branding.domain_note: Uses interfaze.ai; secondary sources say the company previously operated as JigsawStack.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and technical, focused on precision ('One model you trust instead of a shaky pipeline')

branding.brand_signature: One model you trust instead of a shaky pipeline

rebrands.why: not stated; reported by secondary sources only

branding.community_and_virality: Posted on Hacker News (Show HN) and listed on Peerlist; open-weight release invites community use. No fan or merch evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive coinage but close to interface.ai and similar names, and a recent rename means little accumulated brand equity.

outcome_analysis: Interfaze is a Spring 2026 company that appears to continue the earlier JigsawStack developer API business under a new name and architecture. It has published a paper, benchmarks and an open-weight Lite model, but no named customers or verified funding. The outcome is open and depends on whether benchmark gains hold against fast-moving lab models.
notes: Unverified funding: PitchBook shows $1.5M total with Founder Factor, Transpose Platform Management, Y Combinator, Ada Ventures and Antler; Standout says $2.2M pre-seed; FundedIQ says $500K June 2026. Figures conflict and some may belong to the JigsawStack predecessor, so no round is recorded. Founders' employers and education are not on the YC page. The JigsawStack link comes from search summaries of secondary pages (standout.work, yespress). Completeness pass: the pre-seed of 1M USD in 2025-03 led by Ada Ventures was reported by e27 for JigsawStack, the predecessor name (CB Insights dates it 2025-03-12). Rests on a single outlet plus CB Insights. Total raised conflicts (CB Insights 1.5M over three rounds, Standout 2.2M, FundedIQ 500K), so earlier rounds are a known gap and are not recorded.
